args.title: Juniper cold-chain research: combined summary (main + subscriber companion)
args.body:
Sources: https://blog.juniper.example/2026/cold-chain and companion at https://insights.juniper.example/cold-chain/companion (opened with team subscription code SUB-1510).

- Live sensor data sharing between carriers drove a 30% drop in temperature excursions in 2026 cold-chain operations.
- The financial upside came mainly from fewer rejected loads rather than from reduced spoilage — a useful distinction for any savings model we build.
- The subscriber-only companion reports that pilot programs cut claims by roughly a quarter (25%), corroborating the rejected-load/claims mechanism as the primary value driver.
